title: Ramona
author: Helen Hunt Jackson
description: "Ramona" by Helen Hunt Jackson is a novel written in 1884.
longDescription: Set in Southern California after the Mexican-American War, it follows Ramona, a mixed-race Scottish-Native American orphan raised by a Mexican rancher who resents her heritage.

authorInfo.bio: Helen Hunt Jackson (1830–1885) wrote Ramona. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
